en.name: Exponential growth
en.title: Exponential Growth Explained: Rice on a Chessboard
en.description: One grain on the first square, then twice as many on each next one. How much rice lands on the last? Walk the board and compare linear and exponential growth.
en.og_alt: Exponential growth: how much rice lands on the last square of a chessboard?
